name: talkivio
description: Real-time website live chat and customer engagement platform

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @talkivio/contracts build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web,widget -c gray,cyan,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @talkivio/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @talkivio/api dev" "pnpm --filter @talkivio/api dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @talkivio/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @talkivio/widget dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @talkivio/contracts build && pnpm --filter @talkivio/widget build && pnpm --filter @talkivio/api build && pnpm --filter @talkivio/dashboard build
scripts.bootstrap:local: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm db:prepare && pnpm db:seed
scripts.verify:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
